Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

  • We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

Location: Remote - Canada

 

About the Role:

As a backend-focused Senior Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, constructing, and maintaining APIs, services, and systems across our engineering team. This multifaceted position involves developing new features on a large scale, refining internal tooling and processes, contributing to product and technical roadmaps, and assuming diverse responsibilities within the organization. The ideal candidate for the backend role will have a proven track record in building highly available APIs, with additional proficiency in data pipelines and the relevant domain.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Design, create, and maintain robust, efficient, and reliable backend services to meet our platform's evolving needs.

  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to architect and implement new services from inception to delivery.

  • Contribute to developing new features and capabilities that deliver substantial value to our customers.

  • Work with various engineering and product teams to synchronize efforts and deliver cutting-edge solutions.

  • Craft and maintain user-facing technical documentation, enhancing user understanding and facilitating seamless adoption of our services.

  • Play a pivotal role in shaping our company's engineering culture, ensuring the maintenance of high engineering standards across the organization.

 

What you’ll need:

  • 7+ years of proven experience as a Software Engineer specializing in web backend development.

  • Proficiency in Golang is a significant advantage.

  • Additional experience in data engineering is highly desirable.

  • A track record of successfully delivering high-quality production services and systems.

  • Customer-centric approach with a strong emphasis on empathy towards users.

  • Relevant industry experience, particularly in banking or fintech, and domain knowledge in fraud prevention or compliance.

  • Proficient in English - from casual chats to formal reports.

 

Technologies we use:

  • TypeScript (React + node)

  • Golang

  • Ruby

  • Bigtable

  • Postgres / PostgreSQL

  • GCP dataflow (apache beam)

  • BigQuery

  • Python

  • Java

  • Terraform

  • Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

  • Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

  • Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

About Notabene

Notabene is on a mission to make crypto a part of the everyday economy. Leading crypto organizations use our tools to reduce transaction risk and make crypto transfers safe. Working across three continents in eight countries, the Notabene team serves our fantastic community of 100+ customers, including financial institutions, fintechs, exchanges, and more. Our co-founders spearheaded foundational Self Sovereign Identity protocols and use-cases. This technology is key to the internals of our cutting edge tech stack.

We’re proud to have the support of leading investors, including Y Combinator, Jump Capital, Castle Island, Green Visor Capital, and more.

We’re at an exhilarating moment in our journey, as regulation technologies (reg-techs) are fast becoming recognized as a vital enabler of the crypto ecosystem. Notabene is growing fast—and we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry!

The Impact You'll Have:

Every crypto transfer we touch moves between institutions that run their own systems, answer to different regulators, and have no reason to trust each other. The software in the middle has to be right every time. A message processed twice, a lost update, or a record shown to the wrong tenant is a compliance failure for our customers.

You’ll work on the core platform that carries this data between institutions around the world, written in Go.

As a Staff Engineer on the team you’ll build the hardest parts of it, contribute to its design, and help the engineers around you do their best work.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build core parts of our transaction platform.

  • Build for correctness under failure, with the isolation and auditability a regulated product needs.

  • Scale the platform as transaction volume and the number of institutions per node grow, keeping latency predictable and the database healthy.

  • Write design docs for what you build, and give sharp, useful reviews on other people’s designs and code.

  • Build with AI agents every day, and help improve the specs, context and review practices that make agent-written code safe to ship in a regulated product.

  • Work with product, compliance and customer-facing teams to turn regulatory and customer needs into working software.

  • Own what you ship in production, from tracing and alerts to incident follow-ups.

  • Mentor engineers on the team.

  • Work on an on call rotation

Must Haves

  • Systems design depth. You’ve designed and owned distributed systems where correctness matters more than features. You know asynchronous processing well and can reason about what happens when parts of it fail.

  • Strong Go, or deep production experience in another statically typed backend language (Java, Kotlin, Rust, C#) and the appetite to be shipping Go within your first weeks.

  • PostgreSQL in depth: schema design, query plans, locking and isolation levels, migrations on live systems, and multi-tenant data.

  • End-to-end ownership in the cloud. Working knowledge of AWS or GCP: IAM, networking, managed databases, queues and storage. You can read and change Terraform and debug production from traces and logs.

  • AI-native engineering. You use coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor every day and can show how. You write the specs and context, break work down for them, and review their output as hard as a human pull request. You know where they fail.

  • Staff-level experience. A track record of delivering large, technically hard projects end to end and helping the engineers around you get better. Typically 8+ years building backend systems.

  • Clear, concise writing in a remote company that makes decisions in documents and async threads.

  • Security fundamentals for sensitive data: encryption in transit and at rest, key handling, minimising personal data, and least-privilege access.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Applied cryptography: encryption, signing and key management.

  • Decentralized identity: DIDs, verifiable credentials, DIDComm.

  • Regulated finance, payments or compliance: Travel Rule, AML, ISO 20022.

  • Building and running software under SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls.

  • Crypto and blockchain knowledge: chains, addresses, assets, CAIP identifiers.

  • Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Queue and workflow systems, and modern observability tooling.

Benefits

  • Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere!

  • $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment.

  • MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs.

  • Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need.

  • Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you’re returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.

Notabene is proud to be an equal employment workplace and an affirmative action employer. By valuing inclusion and diversity of all forms, we strictly prohibit and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

We're looking for a Head of Security to build and lead security at Airtm, reporting to the VP of Engineering. You'll own the security posture of the systems that move people's money across borders, from application code and cloud infrastructure to identity, vendors, and incident response. You'll set the strategy, build the team and the practices around it, and stay hands-on enough to make the hard technical calls yourself.

Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices on Kubernetes (AWS), with React front ends, organized into autonomous product teams. Security here works as an enabler embedded in how teams ship, not a gate at the end. AI-assisted development is core to how we build, so you'll be expected to use AI tooling fluently for security work, and to define how we adopt AI agents and LLM-powered systems safely.

Key Responsibilities

  • Security Strategy & Roadmap: Define and own a risk-based security strategy for a financial platform; prioritize investment by real threat and business impact, and report on posture to executive leadership and the board

  • Incident Response: Own detection, response, and recovery for security incidents; maintain runbooks, lead incidents and post-incident reviews, coordinate with forensics, legal, and communications, and turn every incident into lasting improvements

  • Application Security: Embed security into the SDLC with threat modeling, secure design reviews, SAST/DAST/dependency scanning, and secure coding standards that engineers actually adopt

  • Cloud & Infrastructure Security: Partner with Infrastructure to harden AWS, Kubernetes, networking, and CI/CD pipelines; own IAM and least-privilege access, secrets management, and security in Terraform and GitOps workflows

  • Detection & Monitoring: Build the detection and alerting capability that finds malicious activity early, across application, infrastructure, and access logs, and tune it to keep signal high

  • Crypto & Key Security: Own the security model for key management, wallet and custody operations, and the blockchain integrations our payment rails depend on

  • Fraud & Account Security Collaboration: Work with Product and Risk teams on account takeover, abuse, and transaction-level controls

  • AI Security: Define guardrails for AI coding tools and for AI agents and LLM pipelines we build or deploy, including agent permissions, prompt injection, data exposure, and tool-access boundaries

  • Compliance & Assurance: Own our security compliance program (SOC 2 and related frameworks), audits, and customer and partner security questionnaires, aiming to make compliance a byproduct of good engineering rather than a separate burden

  • Vendor & Third-Party Risk: Run vendor risk assessments and security due diligence for partners, investors, and acquirers

  • Vulnerability & Patch Management: Establish clear SLAs by severity and keep remediation moving across teams without becoming a bottleneck

  • Team Building & Mentorship: Hire, grow, and lead security engineers; build a security champions network inside product teams; raise the security bar across all of engineering

  • On-Call & Escalation: Participate in and help shape the security escalation path for production incidents

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in information or application security, including 3+ years leading security teams or functions

  • Demonstrated experience leading incident response for real, high-stakes incidents, including coordination with external forensics and counsel

  • Strong knowledge of AWS security and Kubernetes security (IAM, network segmentation, RBAC, secrets management, container and image security)

  • Hands-on experience with application security in a microservices environment: threat modeling, secure code review, and dependency and supply-chain risk

  • Experience building detection and monitoring capabilities (SIEM, log analysis, alerting; Datadog or similar)

  • Experience owning or leading a compliance program such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI-DSS, including audit cycles

  • Ability to read and review TypeScript/Node.js code and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform); you don't need to be a full-time developer, but you need to be credible with engineers

  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and software supply chains

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) for security work, and a clear point of view on the risks of AI-generated code and agentic systems

  • Strong communication skills; able to explain risk to engineers, executives, regulators, and customers, and to write policies and runbooks people follow

  • Sound judgment under pressure; able to make fast, defensible calls with incomplete information

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech, payments, remittance, or crypto environments, especially key management, custody, and blockchain security

  • Experience with fraud, account takeover, and abuse prevention

  • Experience securing AI agents and LLM-powered systems in production (prompt injection defenses, tool-permission models, eval and red-teaming approaches)

  • Hands-on offensive security experience (penetration testing, red teaming) or running bug bounty programs

  • Experience with cloud-native security tooling (CSPM, runtime protection, policy-as-code such as OPA/Kyverno)

  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements for money transmission and financial services across multiple jurisdictions

  • Security certifications (CISSP, CISM, OSCP, AWS Security Specialty)

  • Experience supporting investor, buyer, or enterprise due diligence on security posture

  • Experience building a security function from a small base in a fast-growing engineering org

What We Look For

Beyond the technical skills, we're looking for a leader who:

  • Takes ownership of security outcomes, stays calm and clear in an incident, and communicates early when risk is rising

  • Treats security as a partnership with engineers, building guardrails and paved roads rather than gates and tickets

  • Has good judgment about risk, knowing when to stop a release, when a small risk is worth the speed, and how to explain the tradeoff to the business

  • Improves the team around them, through mentorship, champions, and making secure choices the easy ones

  • Collaborates across boundaries, working with Product, Infrastructure, Legal, Compliance, and Support as one team

  • Knows when (and when not) to lean on AI tooling, and brings rigor to how we adopt it safely

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Platform Sales team is a highly consultative, enterprise sales team that is responsible for some of Stripe’s largest and fastest growing partners. Stripe helps software platforms offer more value to their customers by embedding Stripe’s powerful payments technology and financial services into their solution. As a Platform Sales Manager, you will play a critical role on our go-to-market leadership bench-- leading a team of growth AEs to make embedded payments and financial services a competitive advantage for high-growth organizations.

What you’ll do

  • Drive sales growth through successful leadership, organizational planning, customer service and outstanding execution 
  • Oversee the expansion of Stripe’s footprint with global saas platforms
  • Make hiring decisions, honing our ideal candidate profile and onboarding strategy
  • Create structure and focus for GTM ideas and product sales campaigns that the product team is exploring. Drive execution and measurement. Analyze results and make recommendations for action in a timely manner.
  • Define key sales support mechanisms, processes, and programs to meet the rapid growth of the business and achieve revenue attainment and market development objectives
  • Build a world-class organization and write the playbook for the era of monetizing payments on platform

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of sophisticated Existing Business, Platform AEs across multiple regions focused on expanding our global footprint with enterprise SaaS platforms
  • Drive deal strategy and partner across the business to ensure healthy pipeline, funnel conversion, win rate, and margin preservation across the portfolio
  • Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Stripe's product roadmap and drive best practices on selling and forecasting
  • Engage with the largest strategic opportunities, leading executive relationships 
  • Being accountable for delivering revenue growth

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of relevant enterprise sales experience

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. About the team

The Compute Foundation group builds and operates the core systems that enable every Stripe engineer to ship code, configuration, and infrastructure changes safely and at high velocity. Embedded on the Imaging team, you will design, build, and distribute Linux machine images; manage host bootstrapping and OS-configuration systems; oversee OS packages and security-patching infrastructure; and provide platforms that empower service teams to safely run workloads across cloud providers and regions.

What you’ll do

Own the foundation of Stripe’s compute fleet: Stripe’s services rely on host infrastructure that boots reliably, receives accurate configurations, and operates safely. Your decisions will directly shape the base operating system, package ecosystems, security posture, and bootstrap behavior of Stripe’s fleet.

Lead active architectural transformations: The team is driving key platform evolutions, including modernizing the OS configuration layer, containerizing workloads, scaling machine image distribution across multi-cloud regions, and streamlining OS upgrades and critical security patching.

Drive broad, end-to-end host lifecycle ownership: Work across the entire host lifecycle - from image construction, package distribution, kernel and OS configuration, early boot/systemd, storage, networking initialization, and workload readiness. You will tackle complex engineering challenges that balance reliability, security, compliance, developer experience, and performance.

Your judgment prevents fleetwide incidents: Changes to machine images, packages, kernels, bootstrap systems, and host configuration can have broad consequences. You will design validation, canarying, rollout, health-evaluation, and rollback mechanisms that contain blast radius and make foundational infrastructure changes safer.

Agency to shape technical strategy: As a Staff engineer, you will set technical direction for the team’s systems, author designs that span multiple teams, mentor engineers and be the person engineering managers and engineers rely on for the technical north-star.

Responsibilities

  •  Lead large, ambiguous infrastructure projects from initial design through production launch, broad adoption, and long-term operation. Define the architecture and success criteria, sequence the work, resolve technical ambiguity, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and shepherd projects to measurable impact.
  • Set technical direction for the evolution of Stripe’s host infrastructure, including how machine images are built, validated, distributed, and operated. Guide thoughtful decisions about when to containerize workloads and when host-based approaches remain appropriate.
  • Design systems and practices that make broad infrastructure changes safe and predictable. Establish strong validation, staged rollout, observability, and rollback capabilities. Build guardrails that prevent unhealthy changes from progressing and give operators clear, actionable information when failures occur.
  • Lead incident response for the systems the team owns. Systematically reduce operational toil and make reliability, security, debuggability, and maintainability first-class properties of the platform. 
  • Partner with technical leaders across infrastructure, security, compliance, and service teams to represent the Imaging team’s perspective and align on shared technical direction. Build strong relationships with partner teams and lead work that crosses organizational and system boundaries.
  • Lead critical design reviews and establish standards for the safety, reliability, operability, and usability of Stripe’s host infrastructure. Mentor senior engineers through high-stakes architectural decisions. Raise the quality of designs and implementations through hands-on coding, code review, debugging, and operational leadership.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of designing and shipping production infrastructure systems of significant scale and complexity. 
  • Proven ability to lead large, ambiguous infrastructure projects end-to-end - from technical design through delivery - including managing cross-team dependencies and coordinating migrations across many consuming teams. 
  • Deep expertise in Linux systems, including boot and initialization, systems, processes, networking, filesystems, storage, packages, and production debugging.
    Strong foundations in cloud compute infrastructure, including machine images, virtual machines, autoscaling fleets, launch configuration, block storage, IAM, health evaluation, and multi-region operation in AWS, Azure, or an equivalent environment.
  • Experience designing or operating fleet-scale image, host-management, configuration-management, or infrastructure-provisioning systems.
  • Experience with safe infrastructure rollout practices, including automated validation, canarying, progressive rollout, health evaluation, rollback, and blast-radius containment.
  • Strong background in service reliability and operational excellence: demonstrated ability to lead incident response, reduce toil, and build systems that are reliable, debuggable, and maintainable by a team. 
  • Track record of broad technical impact across multiple large systems: fluency across a complex codebase, force- multiplier effect through code review and mentorship, and the ability to set technical direction for a team rather than just execute within it. 

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building modern image-based, immutable, or declarative infrastructure platforms.
  • Expertise with containers, Kubernetes, and migrating VM-based workloads to managed platforms
  • Experience operating large-scale Linux fleets across AWS, Azure, or multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with progressive delivery, automated validation, fleet health signals, and rollback systems.
  • Experience modernizing legacy configuration-management or host-provisioning systems.
  • Knowledge of OS security patching, software supply-chain security, and artifact provenance.
  • Strong developer-platform instincts, with experience building safe abstractions and self-service workflows.

Who We Are

The Solana Foundation is a non-profit based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the adoption, decentralization, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a high performance blockchain that can deliver a fast and friendly user experience, without sacrificing security. The Solana Foundation is working to realize a world where individuals own their data, use permissionless networks, and transfer information and value freely around the world. We are looking for talented people who are willing to jump right in and use their expertise to help the ecosystem build.

What We Do

The Solana Foundation's marketing and communications team tells the story of what is being built on Solana. We work across developers and founders, traders

and crypto-native users, institutions and capital-market participants, payments companies and merchants, enterprises and consumer platforms, and the policymakers and media who shape how all of it is understood. We are deliberately lean, fast, and close to the work.

The Opportunity

The people forming a view of Solana now include payments executives, asset managers, central bank staff, congressional offices and consumer press - audiences with no patience for jargon and a long memory for the network's early reliability problems. At the same time, the original audience of developers, validators and the extremely online will punish anything that reads as corporate. Holding both at once is the craft this role is hired for.

We are looking for a VP, Communications to own the global narrative and the reputation of the network end to end. You will set the handful of things Solana should be understood for, build the tier-one relationships that carry them, and own incidents and issues responses when the news cycle turns. This is a hands-on role with a function to build behind it: you will write the statement, make the call, and design the system that lets a small team operate at the scale of a much larger one.

One thing to be clear about before you apply. The Foundation does not own the Solana network. We cannot direct the validator operators, the client engineering teams, the infrastructure providers or the loudest voices in the ecosystem, and we cannot issue a statement on anyone's behalf. The work is not message control. It is building the conditions in which an accurate story travels faster than an inaccurate one and enough trust across the ecosystem that independent parties choose to coordinate with you in the first hour of a bad day rather than the fourth.

To be Successful in this role

You will:

  • Define and maintain a global narrative for Solana built around a handful of defensible claims, with the discipline to eliminate competing messages that dilute the story.

  • Build and personally maintain tier-one media relationships across U.S. business, financial, technology, and crypto-native press.

  • Own reputation and issues management across network incidents, client bugs, application-layer exploits, validator disputes, and other high-stakes moments, establishing severity tiers, named decision-makers, rehearsed processes, and pre-drafted response language.

  • Provide executive positioning and communications counsel to Foundation leadership, including candid pushback when needed.

  • Build a bench of credible external technical voices who can independently explain and advocate for Solana, recognizing that the most persuasive validation often comes from outside the Foundation.

  • Provide communications support to ecosystem teams, including launch support, founder media training, and shared narrative infrastructure that smaller companies could not build independently.

  • Translate protocol and governance changes for a wide range of audiences, from stake-weighted voters and technical participants to readers with no prior understanding of validators or blockchain infrastructure.

  • Coordinate with Policy and Legal on regulatory and legislative moments, including work alongside the Solana Policy Institute.

  • Develop a measurement framework focused on narrative accuracy and reputation outcomes, including how accurately Solana is described in independently generated coverage and how quickly misinformation is corrected—not simply clip counts.

You ideally have:

  • Roughly 10 to 15 years in communications, with meaningful time in a high-scrutiny environment: a regulated industry, a platform under sustained press attention, a political or advocacy context, or a company that had a genuinely bad year and came through it

  • Personal experience running a situation where the facts were unclear, the clock was running, and the wrong sentence would have made it worse

  • Direct relationships with tier-one business, financial and technology journalists, and a view on which four are worth real investment

  • The ability to hold a technical conversation with engineers and come out with something true, accurate and repeatable by someone who does not understand it

  • Experience earning coverage on a hard story with no news hook, using patience and proof rather than access

  • A track record of operating with influence rather than authority: coalitions, consortia, federated organizations or open-source projects
